# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `korpiai` MCP server pointing at KorpiAI's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://backend.korpi.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with KorpiAI user sign-in. No API key to configure.
- Logo: KorpiAI mark from the `KorpiAI` GitHub organization avatar.
